材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章用人口增长、外围低密度扩张与旧道路格局解释达累斯萨拉姆的出行困境，再引出选择快速公交的背景。人口预测与现实记录分开呈现；公交被认为更便宜、更可实现，并非已经解决全部交通问题。

原文片段 · 1
Dar es Salaam in Tanzania is one of the fastest growing cities in Africa. Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 and swells by half a million people every year. United Nations projections anticipate it will become a megacity within seven years as its population passes 10 million, reaching 13.4 million by 2035. Daniel Hoornweg for the Global Cities Institute forecasts the city could be home to an incredible 73.7 million people by 2100.

人口已经增长八倍是过去到原文当下的变化；未来成为千万人口城市，以及2035年、2100年的规模则是不同来源的预测。anticipate、forecasts 和 could 标出预测性质。开头的作用是让后面的交通需求放在急速扩张的城市规模里理解。

原文片段 · 2
Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours. It can be longer if rain turns the dirt roads to mud.

大部分居民住在不断向外扩展的单层非正规住区，往返中心耗时很长；雨水还会把土路变成泥路。空间距离和道路条件一起影响通勤。informal settlements 描述缺少正规规划等条件的住区，不能简单理解为居民随意居住。

原文片段 · 3
Even in the middle of the day, traffic frequently slows to a stop without warning. It is not unusual for cars and minibuses to queue for 20 minutes at a key intersection. A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south but is tiny in the context of the wider city. Outside the centre many rely on boda boda (motorbike taxis) to navigate the narrow side streets and potholed mud roads that make up much of the metropolis. Their safety record is scandalous.

拥堵并不限于上下班时段，现有铁路覆盖也很有限。摩托车出租能穿过狭窄街道，却伴随很差的安全表现。段落展示居民面对的是速度、覆盖与安全的多重约束，而不仅是有没有某一种交通工具。

原文片段 · 4
Dar es Salaam's reliance on four arterial roads into the city is a legacy of the colonial government that planned the city at the start of the 20th century to cater for a population of 35,000. Most of the current growth is made up of young people arriving from the countryside to find work, and as the population has exploded, Dar es Salaam has grown around those four highways. Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.

四条主干道来自为小得多的人口设计的殖民时期规划。后来大量年轻人进城找工作，城市围绕旧路向边缘扩张，却缺少共同策略。legacy 指过去制度或规划留下的长期影响；旧骨架承受新规模，解释了前面出行问题的结构背景。

原文片段 · 5
But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car. Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro. It has chosen a less exciting but cheaper and more achievable method: the bus.

But 将叙述转向当地希望采用的方案：快速公交可能提供一种不由私家车主导的发展路径。作者把公交与地铁比较，强调成本与可实现性，而不是把技术是否令人兴奋作为首要标准。could offer 保留了方案潜力尚待实现的意味。

词语与搭配
informal settlements

非正规住区

城市研究中描述未完整纳入正规规划或基础设施体系的居住区域；不要直接等同于所有低收入社区。

to cater for a population of

为某一规模的人口提供服务

cater for 不只表示提供餐饮，这里指规划满足人口需求。

on the periphery

在城市边缘

the periphery 与中心相对，可用于描述城市扩张的空间方向。

pinning its hopes on

把希望寄托在……上

pin one's hopes on 后接计划或方案，带有期待色彩，不能代替对成效的实际证明。

句子精读
Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours.

在作者叙述时，这座城市五分之四的居民住在不断向外扩展的城市边缘的单层非正规住区，从那里往返市中心经常需要两个多小时。

its 指达累斯萨拉姆。主干是 people live in settlements，single-storey 描述房屋形态，on the spreading edges 补充所在位置。where 回接这些外围地点，说明居民从该处出行的耗时。

But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car.

但达累斯萨拉姆正把希望寄托在一个可能为非洲超大城市提供不同发展模式的方案上，让这些城市有机会选择另一条道路，而不是走向由私家车主导的未来。

that could offer 修饰 solution，could 表示可能性。giving them 补充这种方案可能带来的作用，them 指非洲超大城市。controlled by the private car 修饰 future，private car 泛指以私家车为核心的出行模式。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
on the periphery

在城市外围

用于讨论住房位置与服务距离，需要说明外围扩张带来的具体条件，不能据此断定所有郊区住房都不好。

用于写作：高层住宅题涉及如何在大城市提供足够住房；这一表达帮助比较外围扩张与紧凑建设的出行影响。

a future controlled by the private car

由私家车主导的未来

适合描述城市发展的整体方向，随后应解释公共交通如何提供现实替代。

用于写作：直接回应交通题鼓励替代交通方式的主张；不自动推出必须统一限制所有地区的汽车拥有量。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

原第6–9段连续裁切，包含所有8个填空证据。路线未来阶段按文章当时的计划理解。

原文片段 · 1The DART bus rapid transit (BRT) system runs on bus lanes separated from other traffic, mostly in the middle of the road to reduce stoppages. Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.

原文片段 · 2'The new buses are much, much better,' says Paulas George, a young IT worker. He takes the bus every day and it has cut his journey time by two-thirds. He says it is not perfect, though, complaining that drivers often refuse to turn on the air conditioning to save fuel.

原文片段 · 3That is not the only problem. A shortage of buses after a serious flood at the main depot during the rainy season means the system is carrying 200,000 people a day - half the expected capacity. Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working either, forcing passengers to buy individual paper tickets for every journey. Each is printed with a scannable QR code, but there are no scanners. Staff stand by the gates and tear tickets as people enter. As a result, queues are considerable at peak times.

原文片段 · 4Morogoro Road to the north-west of the city was phase I of the BRT project. Phases II and III will install bus lanes along Nyerere Road to the south-west and Kilwa Road to the south. Construction on both routes is due to start imminently. Phase IV, towards Bagamoyo in the north, is in the preliminary design stage. 'Much of the city will have access to a world-class transport system within the space of a few years,' says Chris Kost, the Africa director of ITDP (the Institute for Transportation and Development Policy). All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.

材料精读 · 内容与词句

这一部分先讲快速公交为什么能提高通行效率与可达性，再用乘客体验和设备故障说明设计与运行的差别，最后交代扩建计划。便利来自专用车道、提前检票和无台阶车辆等具体安排，也依赖车辆、票务和维护正常运作。

原文片段 · 1
The DART bus rapid transit (BRT) system runs on bus lanes separated from other traffic, mostly in the middle of the road to reduce stoppages. Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.

专用车道与其他车辆分隔，减少公交受混合交通阻塞的机会；购票和检票放在上车之前，可以减少登车环节的拖延。无台阶车辆让轮椅使用者及推婴儿车的人更容易使用线路。accessible 在这里是实际能进入和使用，不只是知道线路在哪里。

原文片段 · 2
'The new buses are much, much better,' says Paulas George, a young IT worker. He takes the bus every day and it has cut his journey time by two-thirds. He says it is not perfect, though, complaining that drivers often refuse to turn on the air conditioning to save fuel.

乘客 Paulas 的通勤时间缩短了三分之二，但司机为节油不开空调使体验打了折扣。个人评价同时含有改善和不满，though 承接这种转折。原文描述的是这名乘客的经历，不能将相同降幅推给每一位乘客。

原文片段 · 3
That is not the only problem. A shortage of buses after a serious flood at the main depot during the rainy season means the system is carrying 200,000 people a day - half the expected capacity. Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working either, forcing passengers to buy individual paper tickets for every journey. Each is printed with a scannable QR code, but there are no scanners. Staff stand by the gates and tear tickets as people enter. As a result, queues are considerable at peak times.

洪水损坏车库后的车辆短缺使运量只有预期的一半；读卡器和扫码器问题又迫使乘客每次买纸票、工作人员手撕票。技术功能存在于票面或系统设计中，却未真正发挥作用，因此高峰排队明显。That 回接空调问题，说明后面还有更多运行困难。

原文片段 · 4
Morogoro Road to the north-west of the city was phase I of the BRT project. Phases II and III will install bus lanes along Nyerere Road to the south-west and Kilwa Road to the south. Construction on both routes is due to start imminently. Phase IV, towards Bagamoyo in the north, is in the preliminary design stage. 'Much of the city will have access to a world-class transport system within the space of a few years,' says Chris Kost, the Africa director of ITDP (the Institute for Transportation and Development Policy). All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.

叙述从当前故障转向分期扩建：第一期已有线路，第二、三期即将施工，第四期尚在初步设计。完成后约三分之一居民能步行短距离接入网络，是带条件的未来覆盖描述。不同阶段不能都理解成已经建好并投入使用。

词语与搭配
prior to boarding

在上车之前

prior to 比 before 稍正式；to 是介词，后接 boarding，说明购票检票发生的顺序。

accessible to people using wheelchairs

轮椅使用者能够使用

be accessible to 指对某群体可进入、可使用；这里有无台阶设计作为具体支撑。

half the expected capacity

预期运载能力的一半

expected 标明比较基准是预期值，不是原有实际客流量。

within a short walk of

在步行很短距离即可到达……的范围内

常用来描述住宅与车站、服务设施的接近程度；原文用于尚待完成的线路网络。

句子精读
Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.

购票和检票都在乘客上车前于车站进行，而且公交车没有台阶，这意味着轮椅使用者或推着婴儿车出行的人都能使用整条线路。

control 在票务语境中是检票。and 连接车站流程与车辆设计，which means 引出无障碍结果。using wheelchairs 和 who are travelling with baby buggies 都修饰 people，分别列出受益人群；引文保留原文形式。

All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.

各期工程都正在按照高标准规划；待工程完成后，全市三分之一的居民步行很短距离就能到达快速公交网络。

are being planned 表示正在规划。once complete 是省略结构，意思是这些建设完成以后，并不修饰居民。will be 与 once 一起把覆盖率限定为未来完工后的状态。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
accessible to people using wheelchairs

便于轮椅使用者使用

用于说明公共交通替代方案应照顾不同乘客；需配合无台阶入口、站台等具体设计。

用于写作：交通题中的替代方式不只是增加车辆，还包括让不同人群能实际使用。

within a short walk of

距……很近，步行即可到达

说明住房与公交网络的空间联系；是否足够近应由实际布局支持。

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

Choose the correct letter A, B, C or D. 原题Q27–28。

原文第1段In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere. There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity. Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

原文第2段While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'. This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems. But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

原文第3段In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world. The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.

27. What is the writer doing in the first paragraph?

A predicting the future impact of AI
B describing a public perception of AI
C outlining some possible benefits of AI
D highlighting the breadth of the influence of AI
第 27 题作答

28. When discussing AI solutionism in the second paragraph, the writer

A points out a risk involved.
B specifies its probable origins.
C mentions its chief supporters.
D weighs up some pros and cons.
第 28 题作答
保留作答，查看答案

先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

三段讨论人们如何想象AI：媒体渲染的未来图景，认为数据充足就能解决一切的心态，以及这种心态向政策圈的传播。作者承认技术机会，同时批评把机会扩大成万能承诺的思维。

原文第1段
In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere. There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity. Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

第1段写西方许多国家对AI未来的强烈情绪和追求轰动的新闻。could所列的是新闻谈论的潜在能力，you might think则描述只看标题可能形成的印象；不能把“渗透社会每一方面”读成作者已经确认的现状。

原文第2段
While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'. This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems. But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

第2段先承认AI带来大量有前景的机会，再引出“AI万能解决论”。given enough data属于这一心态的信念前提，不是作者承诺数据足够便能解决全部问题。后半说明作者担忧的是忽视安全与制造不现实预期，批评对象是这种思维，而不是一概否定AI。

原文第3段
In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world. The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.

第3段从心态本身转向传播路径：技术圈的宣传进入政府官员和政策制定者的思考。钟摆比喻描述态度由“毁灭人类”转向“拯救人类”的另一个极端；dystopian和utopian分别标出极度悲观与理想化信念，不能当成作者对未来的两项预测。

词语与搭配
no shortage of

大量；并不缺少

后接名词，强调数量充足。此处修饰sensationalist news，数量多并不等于内容可靠。

a wealth of promising opportunities

大量有前景的机会

a wealth of后接不可数或复数名词；promising表示值得期待，不表示成果已经兑现。

given enough data

在数据足够的条件下

given在此引出前提。整个条件位于被解释的信念之内，不能脱离上下文当成作者认可的规律。

setting unrealistic expectations about

对……设定不切实际的预期

set expectations about后面说明预期涉及什么；unrealistic批评的是与实际能力不相称的期望。

The pendulum has swung

钟摆已经摆向另一边；态度转向另一极端

这里是态度变化的比喻，from...to...指出两个极端，不描述机器性能的变化。

句子精读
While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'.

虽然不可否认AI已经打开了大量有前景的机会，但它也促成了一种心态的出现；这种心态最贴切的名称可以说是“AI万能解决论”。

While表示让步；it is undeniable that...里的it是形式主语，that从句是所承认的内容。主句it has also led...中的it回指AI；that can be best described...修饰mindset，说明如何称呼这种心态。

But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

但事实上，这种心态没有支持AI的发展，反而因为忽视重要的AI安全原则，并对AI实际能为人类做什么设定不现实的期望，而危及机器智能的价值。

this mindset回指AI solutionism；instead of supporting与actually jeopardises构成对照。by后面disregarding和setting并列，说明造成风险的两种方式。what从句说明预期涉及的实际能力范围。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
setting unrealistic expectations about

对……设定不切实际的预期

可在avoid等动词后保留setting形式，具体说明期待的成果或时间；不把所有期待都说成不切实际。

用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府科研职责，说明资助研究时如何理解成果周期；并不据此推出应排除私营研究。

no shortage of

大量；不缺

可以承认数字内容数量充足，再讨论数量之外的体验差异。

原文片段 · 1The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life. Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives. Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life. Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.

原文片段 · 2A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar. The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.

原文片段 · 3'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli. She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school - a problem disproportionately affecting female students.

原文片段 · 4Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home. The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas. Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas. They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

A. basic outlook
B. employment opportunities
C. wealthy visitors
D. distant country
E. primary objective
F. similar advantages
G. thriving economy
H. nearby district
I. dense population

第 22 题作答
保留作答，查看答案

先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

德里的语言多样性来自长期居住与人口迁移。研究关注一个表面矛盾：社会中多语现象普遍，一些学生却没有呈现其他教育环境里观察到的益处。文章把调查问题落到家庭语言、学校授课语言、贫困与学习环境之间的关系，而未先判定多语本身有害。

原文片段 · 1
The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life. Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives. Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life. Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.

繁忙街道的声音引出多语言共存，迁入者常怀着更好工作和生活的希望来到首都。有人熟练使用占主导地位的印地语，也有人主要使用其他官方或地区语言。let alone 强调官方语言数量之外还有更多地区语言；统计值与人口描述沿用原文时点。

原文片段 · 2
A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar. The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.

研究团队对千名小学年龄儿童收集资料，目标不是证明会多种语言一定有益或有害，而是理解为何在某些欧洲学校观察到的益处没有出现在许多印度学生身上。observed in schools in Europe 限定比较经验的来源，不能把它扩大为所有欧洲儿童的普遍结论。

原文片段 · 3
'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli. She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school - a problem disproportionately affecting female students.

研究者引述重复出现的低学习表现：许多五年级儿童仍难以完成二年级阅读和减法任务。这里的比较体现学习进展不足，后果可能是辍学，且女生受到不成比例的影响。can lead to 是风险关系，不是说每个表现偏低的儿童都会离校。

原文片段 · 4
Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home. The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas. Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas. They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

研究进一步检查学校授课语言与家庭语言不同是否可能影响学习，同时记录城乡、住区和迁移背景。家庭贫困限制居住选择，迁移又可能造成儿童原有语言与迁入地语言不同。whether 和 could be caused 表示研究中的问题，不能直接改成已经确定的唯一原因。

词语与搭配
in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life

怀着获得更好工作与生活的希望

in the hope of 后接动名词，表达迁移者的动机，不表示愿望必然实现。

The overriding aim

最主要的目标

overriding 强调优先地位；原文用来概括项目需要回答的核心问题。

low educational achievement

较低的学习成就

在文中由具体阅读与计算表现说明，不能直接等同于儿童智力较低。

differs from the language used at home

与家庭使用的语言不同

differ from 比较两个明确对象，这里是学校教学语言和家庭语言。

句子精读
Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home.

Tsimpli 和同事正在调查，这些较低的学习成果是否可能与印度学校的一种情况有关：儿童接受教学的语言常常不同于家里使用的语言。

whether 从句是 investigating 的内容，could be caused 保留待验证的可能性。where 描述学校体系中的情况；that children are taught in 修饰 language，句末的 in 与该语言搭配，表示以某种语言授课。

They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

这些儿童的家庭十分贫困，以至于他们不得不住在贫民区；而且，由于迁移，他们使用的语言可能不同于当地的地区语言。

They 回指从偏远农村迁往城市的许多儿童。so poor 后省略了 that，引出居住条件的结果。and 后另加迁移造成的语言差异，may 保留个体差别；贫困与语言差异不是完全相同的一个原因。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
differs from the language used at home

与家庭语言不同

适合解释某些儿童理解课堂内容时面临的额外要求，避免把语言差异等同于能力不足。

原文片段 · 1Having already tested 1,000 children, the researchers will now embark on retesting them. They intend to look not only at test results, but also at variables such as the standard of schooling, the environment and the teaching practices themselves. It's possible that one of the causes of low performance is the lack of pupil-centred teaching methods; in many Indian primary schools the teacher dominates and there is little room for independent learning.

原文片段 · 2Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life. According to Tsimpli, most of the evidence from this and other projects shows that English instruction for children from low socio-economic areas might not be the best way for them to learn, at least in the first three years of primary education.

原文片段 · 3'What we would recommend for everyone, not just low socio-economic status children, would be to start learning in the language they feel comfortable learning in ... English can still be used, but perhaps not as the medium of instruction in primary schools. It could, for example, be one of the subjects that are being taught alongside other subjects. We are not suggesting that English be withdrawn - that ship has sailed - but we perhaps have to think more about learner needs. There is perhaps too much uniformity in teaching and less tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs,' says Tsimpli.

原文片段 · 4While the preliminary results show there is no difference in general intelligence among boys and girls from slum areas versus those from urban poor backgrounds, an unanticipated finding has been that children from slum backgrounds do not seem to lag behind children from other urban poor backgrounds - and in some cases outperform them (e.g. in numeracy and literacy tasks). According to the researchers, this unexpected finding may be down to the life experiences of children growing up in slums. They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.

23. The researchers have decided against investigating the impact teaching methodology may have on learning outcomes.

Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

第 23 题作答

24. What point does the writer make about primary schools in India in the sixth paragraph?

25. What is Tsimpli suggesting when she uses the phrase 'that ship has sailed'?

Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

A. The findings of the report may be of little help to some Indian schoolchildren.
B. Instruction in English could be better adapted to the needs of schoolchildren.

26. In the eighth paragraph, what do we learn has surprised researchers?

Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

A. Boys and girls from low socio-economic groups have similar general intelligence levels.
B. The age at which children move into a slum does not affect their academic performance.
C. Slum children and children from other urban poor backgrounds have similar life experiences.
D. The literacy and numeracy skills of slum children are not lower than those of children from other urban poor backgrounds.
第 26 题作答
保留作答，查看答案

先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

研究开始把授课语言、教学方式与儿童生活经验一起考虑。作者呈现的是初步结果：陌生的授课语言可能阻碍早期学习，贴合儿童需求比统一要求更合适；贫困住区儿童某些表现较好也不能反过来证明贫困本身有益。

原文片段 · 1
Having already tested 1,000 children, the researchers will now embark on retesting them. They intend to look not only at test results, but also at variables such as the standard of schooling, the environment and the teaching practices themselves. It's possible that one of the causes of low performance is the lack of pupil-centred teaching methods; in many Indian primary schools the teacher dominates and there is little room for independent learning.

再次测试让研究者能继续观察儿童，而不只停留在一次结果。他们也看学校质量、环境和课堂做法；教师主导、缺少自主学习空间只是一个可能原因。It's possible 和 one of the causes 同时限制了因果判断。

原文片段 · 2
Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life. According to Tsimpli, most of the evidence from this and other projects shows that English instruction for children from low socio-economic areas might not be the best way for them to learn, at least in the first three years of primary education.

研究初步发现，入学前及校外很少接触某种授课语言的儿童，可能受到语言本身的阻碍。关于英语不一定最适合的判断，特别限定在经济社会条件较弱儿童的小学前三年，不能读成所有年龄都不该学英语。

原文片段 · 3
'What we would recommend for everyone, not just low socio-economic status children, would be to start learning in the language they feel comfortable learning in ... English can still be used, but perhaps not as the medium of instruction in primary schools. It could, for example, be one of the subjects that are being taught alongside other subjects. We are not suggesting that English be withdrawn - that ship has sailed - but we perhaps have to think more about learner needs. There is perhaps too much uniformity in teaching and less tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs,' says Tsimpli.

建议是先用儿童能自在理解的语言学习；英语仍可作为一门学科，而不必承担教授所有学科的媒介。that ship has sailed 表示完全撤回英语已不是现实方向。作者批评的是教学过于统一、对能力和需求调整不足，重点在怎样教而非排斥某种语言。

原文片段 · 4
While the preliminary results show there is no difference in general intelligence among boys and girls from slum areas versus those from urban poor backgrounds, an unanticipated finding has been that children from slum backgrounds do not seem to lag behind children from other urban poor backgrounds - and in some cases outperform them (e.g. in numeracy and literacy tasks). According to the researchers, this unexpected finding may be down to the life experiences of children growing up in slums. They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.

初步结果中，贫民区儿童在一般智力上并不落后，某些识字与算数活动还表现更好。研究者推测日常生存经验让他们较早接触实用计算，但 may be down to 保留了原因的不确定性。比较对象是其他城市贫困背景儿童，不能直接推成贫困儿童总体优于富裕儿童。

词语与搭配
little room for independent learning

自主学习的空间很少

room 比喻机会和自由度，不是教室面积；与教师占主导的课堂情境相连。

the medium of instruction

教学使用的语言媒介

区分用英语教其他学科与把英语本身作为一门课程，这两者的理解负担不同。

tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs

根据儿童语言能力与需求作调整

tailoring 比喻量体裁衣，强调教学匹配具体学习者，而不是统一提高或降低难度。

essential for day-to-day survival

日常生存所必需的

essential for 后接用途或需要；这里修饰孩子在日常生活中接触的数算技能。

句子精读
Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life.

虽然研究仍处于初步阶段，Tsimpli 及其团队发现，学校使用的授课语言，尤其英语，可能妨碍那些入学前及校外对该语言不熟悉、接触也较少的儿童的学习进展。

Although 先限定发现的成熟程度，may 再限定影响的确定性。who 从句说明是哪一类儿童；familiarity with 与 exposure to 分别表示熟悉和接触，二者共同指向 the language。不能删掉人群与场景限制。

They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.

他们可能更早成熟，也更密切地接触日常生存所必需的数算技能。

They 指在贫民区长大的儿童。are likely to 同时作用于 mature 和 come 两个并列动作，表示研究者的可能解释。essential for day-to-day survival 后置修饰 skills，说明这些技能与生活需要的关系。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
little room for independent learning

自主学习机会不足

用来描述过度由教师控制的课堂，需要说明儿童缺少哪些探索或表达机会。

用于写作：与小学正式教学和课堂游戏的平衡直接吻合，可具体表达过度正式教学的局限。

essential for day-to-day survival

日常生活维持所必需的

只在确实涉及生活压力时使用；可以讨论压力带来的某些实际经验，但不要据此美化贫困。

用于写作：家庭财富题比较成长资源与成年准备；原文提供了生活经验可能培养某些能力的思路，同时例句避免把局部观察扩大为贫困更好的结论。

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 44 页

Q14/15/17：段落信息匹配A–G。Q20–21：Choose TWO letters A–E，顺序不限。Q22–26：Complete the summary. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage.

DThe Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River. The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea. Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala. It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.

EArchaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society. Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps. There are also ceramic discs, and whistles. In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found. The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known. Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.

FBeautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe. A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it. These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold. One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads. These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150. They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.

GThe kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts. Trade routes may also have shifted northwards. Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.

材料精读 · 内容与词句

器物与贸易遗存让作者推测Mapungubwe的跨区域联系、工艺生产和政治权力；金器还显示珍贵材料不只有货币用途。结尾从繁荣转到衰落，并把人口、资源、旱灾和贸易变化作为可能相互作用的因素，而非单一确定原因。

D
D The Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River. The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea. Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala. It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.

动物遗骸和象牙碎片使作者推测皮毛、象牙可能沿林波波河与沿海地区交易；玻璃珠则提示通过沿海商人与印度相连的贸易网络。当地铜以及经过该区域的黄金贸易也带来利益。最后进一步推测，为控制甚至垄断有利可图的区域联系，政治权力可能得到强化。器物发现、贸易路径与政治解释之间是逐层推论，并非所有细节都同样确定。

E
E Archaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society. Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps. There are also ceramic discs, and whistles. In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found. The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known. Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.

大量陶器提示专业陶工可能存在，也被作者用来说明社会繁荣。器物包括容器、杯、碗、陶盘、哨子和动物或人物小像，其中一些有装饰。这些小像可能用于祭祖，但具体用途尚不清楚；当地铜制首饰则补充了手工业种类。形态可以较直接描述，用途仍需保留不确定性。

F
F Beautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe. A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it. These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold. One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads. These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150. They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.

金器工艺包括把金制成小片、刻上几何图样，再用金钉覆盖木制物品；木质部分没有保存下来。可能的权杖、锤打金片制成的犀牛和大量金珠都来自约1150年的王室墓地。作者将这些解释为当地黄金除了交换货币用途，也具有自身珍贵意义的早期已知线索。first known限定的是目前所知证据，并非断言此前绝不可能存在。

G
G The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts. Trade routes may also have shifted northwards. Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.

到13世纪末，王国已走向衰落。作者推测人口过多使资源承压，一系列干旱可能进一步把情况推向危机，贸易路线也可能北移。相比这些可能原因，北方大津巴布韦等地区后来兴盛是文中更明确陈述的趋势。段落保留多种因素共同作用的空间，没有给出唯一被证实的衰落原因。

词语与搭配
in turn

继而、转而

这里连接贸易链的下一环：沿海国家又与从印度来的商人交易，不是说每件物品都由Mapungubwe直接运到印度。

on a scale large enough to suggest

规模大到足以使人推测

large enough to...说明达到某种程度，suggest保留由数量到专业分工的推断性。

their precise function is not known

它们的确切用途尚不清楚

function指器物用途，their回指小像；已知外形不等于已知使用方式。

an intrinsic value of its own

自身具有的内在价值

这里与货币交换价值相对照，描述黄金作为珍贵物品本身的意义。

placed too much stress on local resources

给当地资源施加了过大压力

place stress on后接承压对象，local resources可以包括维持人口和生产所需的资源；本段用probably保留因果判断的限度。

句子精读
The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea.

玻璃珠的出现——这些珠子几乎可以确定来自印度——表明当地曾与沿海其他国家进行某种贸易，而这些沿海国家又与乘船从印度来的商人交易。

主干围绕The presence of glass beads说明其提示的贸易联系。almost certainly from India插入说明珠子的可能来源，of some sort保留对贸易具体形式的未知。who指沿海国家所代表的交易方，in turn引出下一环；travelling...修饰merchants。原文使用indicate，本句引用保留原样，阅读时核心名词presence按常规主谓一致应搭配indicates。

The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts.

到13世纪末，Mapungubwe王国已在衰落，可能因为人口过多给当地资源带来过大压力，而一系列干旱又可能使这种局面达到危机程度。

主干是The kingdom...was already in decline，by限定到某个时间为止的状态。probably because引入可能原因，a situation概括资源受压的局面，that从句进一步说明旱灾可能如何加剧它。may have been brought是对过去事件的可能性判断，不是确认旱灾是唯一原因。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
placed too much stress on local resources

给当地资源带来过大压力

可根据句子时态改为place或places，保留place stress on的搭配。谈旅游时应具体说明水、土地或公共设施等资源，不能把古代王国衰落直接当作现代旅游的实证。

用于写作：题目讨论旅游对当地环境与居民的代价；资源压力能够具体解释游客增长可能产生的成本。

Do the following statements agree with the information? TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。原题Q6–13；NG对照完整原篇后确认，未用裁切缺失信息制造答案。

原文第5段Nevertheless, in many cases REM sleep does seem to have benefits. Growing evidence from birds and mammals suggests that REM sleep and dreaming are important for forming memories and learning. It is believed that when events are replayed in dreams, this helps to integrate memories into longer-term storage. As soon as animals evolved moderately complex lifestyles, they would have needed to dream in order to manage these lifestyles.

原文第6段However, we still don't understand how this outward behaviour relates to internal experience. It seems impossible to know what it is like to be a rat or a pigeon, let alone imagine their dreamscapes. We are quick to interpret the twitching limbs and quiet barks of sleeping dogs, but the truth is that we don't know if there is an internal experience of chasing rabbits that comes along with that.

原文第7段Another non-human dreamer offers insight here. In 2019, while making a documentary, David Scheel of Alaska Pacific University in the USA housed an octopus named Heidi in a tank in his living room. At one point, in the middle of the night, Heidi seemed to dream: her limbs and head moved, and her skin rapidly changed colour, as though she was pursuing a crab.

原文第8段Similarly, a report recently emerged of a sleeping octopus apparently having a nightmare. Costello, as the octopus was called, thrashed around, extended his mantle as if trying to make himself look bigger, and squirted ink as though he were being attacked by a predator. The nightmare study is intriguing, says Scheel, but is only based on one animal. He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

原文第9段The trouble is that we will never be able to experience any animal's dreams. That goes for other humans' dreams too. But we can try to imagine what these dreamscapes are like by meeting animals on their own terms. For example, vision is the dominant sense for many humans, and so our dreams are heavily visual too. Dogs primarily navigate the world using smell while spiders rely much more on vibrations.

原文第10段It is likely that dreaming has served multiple purposes since the first complex animals evolved. And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章先提出梦可能帮助记忆与学习，再用章鱼睡眠行为展示观察的吸引力与局限。结尾提醒我们从动物自身的感官世界理解梦，并把跨物种研究作为理解人类梦境的一条可能路径。

原文第5段
Nevertheless, in many cases REM sleep does seem to have benefits. Growing evidence from birds and mammals suggests that REM sleep and dreaming are important for forming memories and learning. It is believed that when events are replayed in dreams, this helps to integrate memories into longer-term storage. As soon as animals evolved moderately complex lifestyles, they would have needed to dream in order to manage these lifestyles.

鸟类和哺乳动物的证据逐渐支持快速眼动与梦对记忆、学习有重要作用。一种解释认为，梦中重现事件有助于把记忆整合到较长期储存中。关于复杂生活方式促使动物需要梦的说法仍带有推断性；it is believed和would have needed都不是对进化过程的直接录像式描述。

原文第6段
However, we still don't understand how this outward behaviour relates to internal experience. It seems impossible to know what it is like to be a rat or a pigeon, let alone imagine their dreamscapes. We are quick to interpret the twitching limbs and quiet barks of sleeping dogs, but the truth is that we don't know if there is an internal experience of chasing rabbits that comes along with that.

However明确区分外在行为与内在体验：我们容易把睡着的狗抽动和轻吠想象成追逐兔子，但其实不知道它是否真的有这种梦境。人甚至难以知道作为老鼠或鸽子的体验是什么样，更不用说具体的梦世界。这段不是否认动物会做梦，而是限制人类解释行为时可以声称知道多少。

原文第7段
Another non-human dreamer offers insight here. In 2019, while making a documentary, David Scheel of Alaska Pacific University in the USA housed an octopus named Heidi in a tank in his living room. At one point, in the middle of the night, Heidi seemed to dream: her limbs and head moved, and her skin rapidly changed colour, as though she was pursuing a crab.

作者引入2019年章鱼Heidi的观察。它睡眠时肢体、头部活动，皮肤迅速变色，看起来像在追螃蟹。seemed和as though表明这是依据行为作出的类比，而不是已确认章鱼确实梦到了某只螃蟹。

原文第8段
Similarly, a report recently emerged of a sleeping octopus apparently having a nightmare. Costello, as the octopus was called, thrashed around, extended his mantle as if trying to make himself look bigger, and squirted ink as though he were being attacked by a predator. The nightmare study is intriguing, says Scheel, but is only based on one animal. He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

另一只章鱼Costello出现剧烈扭动、伸展外套膜和喷墨，看起来像应对捕食者，因此被描述为可能做噩梦。Scheel认为这很有趣，却指出观察只涉及一只动物，还需要脑成像来支持梦中重演清醒活动的解释。本段将令人印象深刻的个例，与形成更稳固认识所需的证据区分。

原文第9段
The trouble is that we will never be able to experience any animal's dreams. That goes for other humans' dreams too. But we can try to imagine what these dreamscapes are like by meeting animals on their own terms. For example, vision is the dominant sense for many humans, and so our dreams are heavily visual too. Dogs primarily navigate the world using smell while spiders rely much more on vibrations.

作者承认，人无法直接进入其他动物甚至其他人的梦，但可以从物种自己的感官特点出发想象其体验。人类多依赖视觉，狗依赖嗅觉，蜘蛛较依赖振动，因此不能把所有动物的梦都想成一段人类式视觉电影。on their own terms要求尊重不同物种的生活方式。

原文第10段
It is likely that dreaming has served multiple purposes since the first complex animals evolved. And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

结尾提出，梦自复杂动物演化以来可能承担了多种功能；如果如此，更好地理解这些功能也许能帮助理解人类的梦。likely、if、possible和might层层保留条件，作者以开放的研究方向收尾，而没有给出唯一且最终的梦的用途。

词语与搭配
forming memories and learning

形成记忆与学习

两个动名词并列，说明研究讨论的功能；本段说证据逐渐支持相关作用，并未给出适用于所有物种的统一机制。

integrate memories into longer-term storage

把记忆整合进较长期的储存

integrate...into...表示并入某个系统或结构，longer-term是相对较长期，并非永不遗忘。

as well as outward behaviour

除了外在行为以外

as well as在此补充另一类所需证据，后面提出脑成像；不是说行为观察毫无价值。

on their own terms

从它们自身的条件和生活方式出发

their指动物，强调不要只套用人类的感官经验；此处不是交易或谈判中的条款。

shed light on

帮助解释、增进对……的理解

这是照亮的比喻，常用于研究贡献；比prove更克制，不表示一次研究已经解决全部问题。

句子精读
He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

他认为，除了外在行为，还需要脑成像来显示章鱼是否在梦中重演清醒生活中的一连串活动。

He指Scheel；argues that标明这是他的研究判断。主句内容是brain imaging is needed，as well as...补充已有的行为证据。to show说明成像的目的，后面的that从句是待支持的解释；from their waking lives修饰activities，与in dreams形成清醒经历和梦中重演的关系。原文并不是说成像证据已经取得。

And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

如果情况确实如此，那么更好地理解这些功能，或许能帮助我们理解自身梦境的真正用途。

this is the case回指上一句梦可能自复杂动物出现以来承担多种功能。it是形式主语，that从句给出真正内容；better understanding是该从句主语，these purposes指梦的多种功能。if、possible、might共同保留条件和不确定性，不能把整句改述为研究已经确定人类做梦的目的。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
shed light on

帮助增进理解

常见搭配是research/findings may shed light on a process or question。适合讨论基础研究的潜在贡献，同时保留may、could等程度词，不把研究方向写成已经证实的成果。

用于写作：科研由政府还是企业控制的题目涉及研究激励；该表达可用于说明公共资金支持无即时商业回报的基础研究这一理由。它是写作中的政策论点，不是原文对资助模式作出的结论。

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

Q29：Choose A–D. Q30–33：Complete the summary using words A–I. 原选项完整保留。

原文第4段We are now seeing governments pledge support to national AI initiatives and compete in a technological race to dominate the burgeoning machine-learning sector. While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

原文第5段One of the most promising varieties of AI technologies are neural networks. This form of machine learning is loosely modelled on the neuronal structure of the human brain, but on a much smaller scale. But what many politicians do not understand is that simply adding a neural network to a problem will not automatically mean that you'll find a solution. Similarly, adding a neural network to a system of government does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair.

原文第6段AI systems need a lot of data to function, but the public sector typically does not have the appropriate data infrastructure to support advanced machine learning. Most of the data remains stored in offline archives. The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy. More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed. Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

B funding
C skills
D prejudices
E computers
F equality
G framework
H confidentiality
I approval

29. In the fourth paragraph, the writer suggests that many politicians may

A have failed to appreciate the true potential of AI initiatives.

先作答；不确定的题也可记录判断与疑点。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

这三段把AI的宏大承诺拉回公共部门的实施条件。先写政治热情与实际复杂性的落差，再解释神经网络不自动带来结果，最后列出数据、组织流程与人才等条件。它讨论的是技术部署的能力边界，不是说所有政府永远不能使用AI。

原文第4段
We are now seeing governments pledge support to national AI initiatives and compete in a technological race to dominate the burgeoning machine-learning sector. While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

第4段写政府承诺支持国家AI项目，并争取在增长中的产业占据优势。While连接政治人物宣称的变革与作者指出的部署复杂性，重点在愿景与实施之间的距离。many限制为许多政治人物，不能扩大为全部。

原文第5段
One of the most promising varieties of AI technologies are neural networks. This form of machine learning is loosely modelled on the neuronal structure of the human brain, but on a much smaller scale. But what many politicians do not understand is that simply adding a neural network to a problem will not automatically mean that you'll find a solution. Similarly, adding a neural network to a system of government does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair.

第5段介绍神经网络对人脑结构的松散模拟，loosely和on a much smaller scale都限制类比程度。接着指出，把神经网络加入某个问题或政府系统，不会自动意味着找到解决方案或立即获得公平与包容。否定的是自动、即时的效果，而不是说相关技术毫无用途。

原文第6段
AI systems need a lot of data to function, but the public sector typically does not have the appropriate data infrastructure to support advanced machine learning. Most of the data remains stored in offline archives. The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy. More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed. Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

第6段把前段抽象的“复杂性”具体化：数据基础设施不足、资料仍离线、数字资料受行政流程阻碍、部门间访问需要权限，以及专业人才不足。typically、tend to和More often than not均表达常见倾向；Above all把人才放在作者强调的位置。

词语与搭配
pledge support to

承诺支持……

pledge是作出承诺，不等于支持措施已经落实或取得成效。

loosely modelled on

对……作松散的模拟

be modelled on说明参考对象；loosely提示结构借鉴并不等于完整复制。

appropriate data infrastructure

合适的数据基础设施

infrastructure是支持工作运行的基础系统；appropriate强调要符合实际用途，不是设备越多越好。

buried in bureaucracy

受繁琐行政程序阻碍，难以实际获取或使用

buried是比喻，不表示资料真的埋在地下；需要结合数据访问的语境理解。

reap the benefits of

获得并享受到……的益处

reap本义是收获；这里强调实际取得利益，与仅宣布使用某项技术不同。

句子精读
While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

虽然许多政治人物宣扬即将到来的“AI革命”的变革效果，他们却没有认识到在现实世界部署先进机器学习系统的复杂性。

While建立让步与转折；they回指many politicians。around deploying中的deploying是动名词，说明复杂性围绕何种实际工作产生。coming指被宣称即将到来的变化，不表明相关结果已经实现。

Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

尤其重要的是，公共部门通常缺乏具备合适技术能力的人才，因而难以充分获得机器智能的益处。

Above all标出作者特别强调的条件。with the right technological capabilities修饰human talent，to fully reap...说明所需能力服务的目标；typically保留“通常”的范围，不能去掉后写成所有公共部门都没有人才。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
appropriate data infrastructure

合适的数据基础设施

适合具体说明公共科研投入的基础条件；搭配provide或develop时仍需交代研究用途。

用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府资助具有公共价值、商业回报不确定的科研，具体化资金可以支持什么；不是说科研只能由政府执行。

reap the benefits of

实际获得……的益处

后接能够说明来源的资源、经验或合作成果，避免只写空泛的benefits。

用于写作：自编例句，直接回应政府与私企研究是否应排他：用有条件的合作说明可以利用不同主体的专业知识。

Q36–39：YES / NO / NOT GIVEN。Q34–35：选词摘要填空，完整选项A–I保留。按原文顺序编排本段题组，原题号不变。全篇主旨Q40需阅读全文，未列入裁切。

原文第7段For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics. Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots. Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.

原文第8段One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks. This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions. Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms. Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.

原文第9段If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society. This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.

原文第10段Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead. Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.

原文第11段The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI. The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer. Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine. As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.

原文第12段Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals. An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing. The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.

原文第13段There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes. These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything. Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it. All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.

材料精读 · 内容与词句

后半篇从专家对宣传的批评转向安全、伦理与实际用途，再用医疗和司法例子说明部署限制，最后提出有选择地使用AI。作者要求把收益、潜在伤害和人的职责一并考虑，并未主张一律停止技术应用。具体项目经历均按本文叙述理解，不作为当前项目状态的独立核验。

原文第7段
For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics. Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots. Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.

第7段承接前面关于实施困难的讨论，介绍两位研究者的观点：关注日常具体用途，并对广泛部署需要的时间保持现实认识。Brooks的引语谈“几乎所有创新”所需时间比想象长，不是说所有创新最终都会成功或永远无法部署。

原文第8段
One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks. This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions. Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms. Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.

第8段解释对抗性攻击及相关安全问题：恶意AI可能使另一系统作出错误预测。研究者据此警告，在缺乏适当安全标准与防御机制时不应贸然推广。Still将已有警告与安全仍常被忽视的情况并置。

原文第9段
If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society. This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.

第9段以“获得收益并减少潜在伤害”为目标，要求讨论AI在具体领域如何有意义地应用，同时考虑伦理和人们的不信任。meaningfully强调解决实际需要，而不是仅仅把技术放进某个场景。

原文第10段
Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead. Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.

第10段进一步强调认识能力边界与人仍应主导的地方。take a step back是暂退一步冷静审视的比喻；separate...from...要求区分实际能力与幻想，不是说AI完全没有能力。

原文第11段
The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI. The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer. Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine. As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.

第11段按本文叙述，以Watson肿瘤项目说明“设计上希望给出最佳建议”与“使用者实际建立信任”之间的距离。was meant to、developed to都表达目的，不能读成已经证实可靠。most hospitals where it was trialled限定为文中试用该项目的多数医院，不是所有医院或所有医疗AI。

原文第12段
Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals. An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing. The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.

第12段按本文叙述，写一个在美国法院辅助量刑的算法放大结构性种族歧视并被弃用的例子。该段具体说明技术建议可能带来的社会后果；不能从这一系统的经历推出所有司法算法都有同一结果。

原文第13段
There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes. These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything. Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it. All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.

第13段把前面的例子收束为选择使用范围的原则：技术本身不是使用理由，自动化也有成本，并非所有可以自动化的事都应该自动化。may not always与not every都是否定普遍保证，而不是断言AI在任何场景都无用。

词语与搭配
widely deployed

得到广泛部署

deploy在技术语境中指投入使用；widely描述应用范围，不能与实验成功或刚开发出来混同。

appropriate security standards

适当的安全标准

appropriate强调与用途和风险相符的标准；有标准仍不自动意味着风险为零。

minimise the potential harms

尽量减少潜在伤害

minimise指尽量降低，potential表示可能发生；两者都不同于保证完全消除伤害。

be aware of the limitations of

认识到……的局限

limitations常接of说明对象；意识到局限可以帮助确定适用范围，不等于完全拒绝使用。

simply for the sake of AI

仅仅为了使用AI本身

for the sake of可表示目的或理由；simply在这里批评没有实际需要支撑的技术采用。

句子精读
If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society.

如果我们要获得AI的益处并尽量减少其潜在伤害，就必须开始思考机器学习怎样才能有意义地应用到政府、企业和社会的具体领域。

If we are to...表达想实现的目标，must...提出作者认为必要的行动。reap与minimise并列，收益和伤害同时受到关注；how从句说明需要思考的是应用方式，specific areas限制讨论到具体领域。

Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it.

仅仅为了使用AI而使用AI，未必总是有成效或有用；也并非每个问题都最适合通过应用机器智能来处理。

Using AI...是动名词主语；may not always保留“并非总是”的范围。not every issue是部分否定，不等于no issue。by applying...说明处理方式，it回指issue。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
minimise the potential harms

尽量减少潜在伤害

适合与审查、监管和试验条件相连；不能声称审查可以保证消除全部风险。

用于写作：自编例句，直接回应科研应如何受到控制：提出可适用于公共和私营实验室的审查安排，不把监管等同于政府独占所有研究。

be aware of the limitations of

认识到……的局限

后接具体技术或方法；认识边界服务于判断用途，避免演变成空泛反科技态度。

用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府科研监督职责，把能力边界与是否批准扩大应用联系起来。

原文片段 · 1The saiga, a species of antelope native to Central Asia, once roamed the vast grasslands of this region in enormous herds, many millions strong. Regrettably, such spectacular sights are a thing of the past. Today, the saiga is largely confined to a single country: Kazakhstan. This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.

原文片段 · 2The saiga is perfectly adapted to the tough conditions of the remote wilderness of the steppes of Central Asia. One such adaptation is its bizarre bulbous nose, which enables the animal to survive the extreme seasonal temperature swings of the region. The swollen nostrils of the nose serve several purposes: they filter out dust and cool the blood during hot, dry summers, and they warm the cold air before it enters the saiga's lungs in winter. Other seasonal adaptations include a heavy winter coat that the saiga sheds when the weather warms up.

原文片段 · 3Despite these superb adaptations to harsh conditions, the saiga has no defence against the threats posed by humans. It was almost driven to extinction by hunters in the 19th century. Legal protection ensured its survival for a while, and numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century. But the respite was only temporary. In the ten years following the break-up of the former Soviet Union in 1991, over 95% of the global population was lost - one of the fastest examples of species loss ever recorded for a mammal.

原文片段 · 4The dramatic decline during this decade was due to illegal poaching on an industrial scale. Male saiga are a particular target, because their horns are highly prized by traditional medicine practitioners. Poaching reached epidemic levels after misguided conservationists tried to relieve the pressure on threatened African rhinos by actively encouraging the use of saiga horns in traditional medicine as an alternative to those of rhinos. Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.

材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章把赛加羚羊适应自然环境的能力与抵御人为威胁的无力并置：鼻腔、季节性毛被能应对草原气候，却无法阻止猎杀。随后追溯数量恢复又崩溃的历史，并解释一项保护犀牛的倡议怎样把捕猎压力转移给了赛加。

原文片段 · 1
The saiga, a species of antelope native to Central Asia, once roamed the vast grasslands of this region in enormous herds, many millions strong. Regrettably, such spectacular sights are a thing of the past. Today, the saiga is largely confined to a single country: Kazakhstan. This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.

先从过去数以百万计的大群迁徙写到文章叙述时数量集中于哈萨克斯坦，形成鲜明反差。native to 说明物种原产地；largely 和 well over 90% 表示高度集中，却不是其余国家已完全没有赛加。this country 指哈萨克斯坦，the rest 指全球种群中剩下的部分。

原文片段 · 2
The saiga is perfectly adapted to the tough conditions of the remote wilderness of the steppes of Central Asia. One such adaptation is its bizarre bulbous nose, which enables the animal to survive the extreme seasonal temperature swings of the region. The swollen nostrils of the nose serve several purposes: they filter out dust and cool the blood during hot, dry summers, and they warm the cold air before it enters the saiga's lungs in winter. Other seasonal adaptations include a heavy winter coat that the saiga sheds when the weather warms up.

大鼻子看起来奇特，却承担实用功能：夏季过滤尘土并为血液降温，冬季预热进入肺部的空气。冬毛则随着天气转暖脱落。两类例子共同说明适应是器官结构与季节变化的配合；extreme seasonal temperature swings 指季节之间很大的温差。

原文片段 · 3
Despite these superb adaptations to harsh conditions, the saiga has no defence against the threats posed by humans. It was almost driven to extinction by hunters in the 19th century. Legal protection ensured its survival for a while, and numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century. But the respite was only temporary. In the ten years following the break-up of the former Soviet Union in 1991, over 95% of the global population was lost - one of the fastest examples of species loss ever recorded for a mammal.

Despite 把话题从自然适应转到人为威胁。19世纪猎杀几乎使它灭绝，法律保护曾带来20世纪大部分时期的恢复；但1991年之后的十年里，全球数量又损失超过95%。respite 是暂时喘息，不意味着危险从此消失。这里的时间与数量属于原文历史叙述。

原文片段 · 4
The dramatic decline during this decade was due to illegal poaching on an industrial scale. Male saiga are a particular target, because their horns are highly prized by traditional medicine practitioners. Poaching reached epidemic levels after misguided conservationists tried to relieve the pressure on threatened African rhinos by actively encouraging the use of saiga horns in traditional medicine as an alternative to those of rhinos. Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.

本段解释上段所说的骤减：偷猎规模极大，雄性因角的市场价值成为主要对象。一些保护者曾鼓励用赛加角替代犀牛角，结果压力转移到另一个物种。misguided 评价的是这种判断失误；雄性几近消失进一步造成种群崩溃，文中没有把善意等同于有效保护。

词语与搭配
a thing of the past

已成为过去的景象或事物

原文说的是庞大兽群的壮观景象，不是在说赛加这个物种已经灭绝。

is largely confined to

主要局限于

be confined to 后接地区或范围；largely 保留例外，准确表达分布集中。

on an industrial scale

以工业化般的巨大规模

修饰偷猎规模，强调组织化、数量大，并非说偷猎本身属于合法工业。

relieve the pressure on

减轻……承受的压力

原文是减轻犀牛遭捕猎的压力；可接 species、resources 等压力承受对象。

句子精读
This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.

据估计，全球远超90%的赛加羚羊生活在这个国家，其余分布在俄罗斯、蒙古和乌兹别克斯坦。

This country 回指哈萨克斯坦。is estimated to 表示这是估算；be home to 表示是某物的生活地。with 引出补充情况，accounting for 的主语是后面列出的三国；the rest 是剩余种群。

Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.

雄性赛加几乎被捕杀殆尽，造成种群数量暴跌，而这个物种自那以后一直艰难地恢复。

leading to 表示前面事件带来的结果。from which 中 which 指 a population crash，recover from 表示从打击中恢复。has been struggling 和 ever since 共同突出恢复过程延续到作者叙述时仍未结束。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
on an industrial scale

以极大的、工业化的规模

适合描述技术与设备使资源开采规模扩大；不能把所有小型经营都称为 industrial scale。

用于写作：过度捕捞题讨论捕捞能力与生态压力，大型船舶造成的规模效应与原文大规模猎杀直接相关。

relieve the pressure on

减轻……所承受的压力

说明措施帮助哪个对象；on 后接鱼群、生态系统等，随后解释压力怎样减少。

用于写作：直接用于过度捕捞的措施段，把休渔与鱼群恢复相连；不套用赛加保护倡议的历史结果。

这里包含原文后半部连续5段。两道NOT GIVEN已同时核对完整原文；不是因为裁切省略了答案。种群数和now按原考试文章时间理解。

原文片段 · 1Another threat to the survival of the saiga is loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement. Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species. In the worst cases, herds may starve to death after being trapped.

原文片段 · 2Then there is the risk of disease. In 2015, an outbreak of haemorrhagic septicaemia, caused by the normally harmless bacterium Pasteurella multocida, killed over 75% of the global adult saiga population in just three weeks. In 2017, 60% of the Mongolian saiga population - a subspecies found nowhere else in the world - was killed by a virus that spilled over from livestock. These so-called mass mortality events represent an unpredictable and serious threat to the species.

原文片段 · 3Climate change poses a further threat. Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate. Experts believe that unusually warm weather may have triggered the 2015 mass mortality event. The steppe region has also become increasingly arid in recent years, and many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished.

原文片段 · 4Recent efforts to save the saiga have been spearheaded by the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, a project led by the Association for the Conservation of Biodiversity of Kazakhstan, working in partnership with the Kazakh government's Committee for Forestry and Wildlife, Frankfurt Zoological Society and Fauna and Flora, an international conservation charity. Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga. In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project, an accolade reserved for the ten best examples of large-scale ecosystem restoration around the globe.

原文片段 · 5So, how many saiga are there now? By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all time low of just 21,000 individuals. There was some recovery in the first decade of the new millennium but this was then crushed by devastating mass mortality events that saw the loss of hundreds of thousands of the species. But thanks to the intervention of the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, the most recent episodes in the ongoing story of the saiga have been relatively uplifting. Three years ago, the Ustyurt Plateau population in Kazakhstan experienced its largest mass birth of saiga calves in many years. An aerial census two years ago recorded an estimated 842,000 saiga across Kazakhstan as a whole, and according to an aerial survey earlier this year, the saiga population in Kazakhstan now exceeds 1.9 million. The world's strangest-looking antelope remains critically endangered, but the direction of travel is positive.

材料精读 · 内容与词句

这部分把保护问题扩展到栖息地、跨境迁徙、疾病和气候的相互作用，再介绍生态系统恢复合作及数量回升。结尾同时保留积极趋势与持续风险；now、今年和几年前都以原文写作时点为准。

原文片段 · 1
Another threat to the survival of the saiga is loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement. Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species. In the worst cases, herds may starve to death after being trapped.

农业和定居点扩张挤压栖息地，铁路、管道及围栏又会切断迁徙通道。这里不只是栖息面积减少，还包括原有空间无法连通；受困兽群甚至可能饿死。transboundary 说明赛加活动跨越国界，管理边界与动物活动边界并不重合。

原文片段 · 2
Then there is the risk of disease. In 2015, an outbreak of haemorrhagic septicaemia, caused by the normally harmless bacterium Pasteurella multocida, killed over 75% of the global adult saiga population in just three weeks. In 2017, 60% of the Mongolian saiga population - a subspecies found nowhere else in the world - was killed by a virus that spilled over from livestock. These so-called mass mortality events represent an unpredictable and serious threat to the species.

两次短期大量死亡说明疾病风险的突然性。2015年的病菌平常无害，却引发严重疫情；2017年蒙古亚种又受到从家畜传播来的病毒影响。normally harmless 并不表示永远无害，spilled over 描述病原从一个动物群体传播到另一个群体。

原文片段 · 3
Climate change poses a further threat. Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate. Experts believe that unusually warm weather may have triggered the 2015 mass mortality event. The steppe region has also become increasingly arid in recent years, and many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished.

能适应常见的寒冬与炎夏，不等于能承受所有极端温度和不规则波动。专家把异常暖天气视为2015年大量死亡的可能诱因，may have triggered 保留了推测程度。干旱和溪流消失则构成另一条影响路径，涉及动物可获得的水源。

原文片段 · 4
Recent efforts to save the saiga have been spearheaded by the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, a project led by the Association for the Conservation of Biodiversity of Kazakhstan, working in partnership with the Kazakh government's Committee for Forestry and Wildlife, Frankfurt Zoological Society and Fauna and Flora, an international conservation charity. Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga. In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project, an accolade reserved for the ten best examples of large-scale ecosystem restoration around the globe.

保护行动由 Altyn Dala 项目牵头，并与政府和国际组织合作。目标是修复草原、半沙漠与沙漠生态系统及其中多个物种，赛加只是重点之一。联合国在2022年的认可体现项目受到重视，原文没有把奖项等同于某种新增资源。

原文片段 · 5
So, how many saiga are there now? By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all time low of just 21,000 individuals. There was some recovery in the first decade of the new millennium but this was then crushed by devastating mass mortality events that saw the loss of hundreds of thousands of the species. But thanks to the intervention of the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, the most recent episodes in the ongoing story of the saiga have been relatively uplifting. Three years ago, the Ustyurt Plateau population in Kazakhstan experienced its largest mass birth of saiga calves in many years. An aerial census two years ago recorded an estimated 842,000 saiga across Kazakhstan as a whole, and according to an aerial survey earlier this year, the saiga population in Kazakhstan now exceeds 1.9 million. The world's strangest-looking antelope remains critically endangered, but the direction of travel is positive.

数量变化并非一路上升：2000年降到低点，随后恢复又遭大量死亡打断，之后才出现出生增加和航空调查记录的回升。文末 positive 指发展方向向好，remains 则保留当时仍有严重风险的判断。这里的年份、估算与保护等级都属于原文语境，不能直接当作今天的状态。

词语与搭配
loss of habitat

栖息地丧失

habitat 指动物赖以生存的环境；与后文迁徙路线被阻断共同描述生存空间的损害。

spilled over from livestock

从家畜传播过来

spill over 在这里比喻病原跨群体传播；livestock 是家畜总称，不是野生动物。

working in partnership with

与……协作

用于说明组织之间共同开展行动；with 后列举合作方。

the direction of travel is positive

总体发展方向是积极的

travel 在这里是趋势比喻，不指赛加的实际迁徙；并不保证以后不会反复。

句子精读
Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate.

赛加虽然很好地适应了寒冷的冬季和炎热的夏季，却难以应对极端温度以及无法预测的气候波动。

Although 后省略了与主句一致的主语和系动词，可理解为 although they are well adapted。主句 struggle to cope with 强调应对困难；两个并列名词短语分别指极端程度和变化的不稳定性。

Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga.

它的目的是保护并修复哈萨克斯坦的草原、半沙漠和沙漠生态系统，以及这些生态系统支持生存的众多物种，其中包括当时处于极危状态的赛加。

Its 指保护项目。protect and restore 是并列目的动作；they support 修饰 species，they 回指 ecosystems。including 表示赛加包含在多个受益物种之中，而不是项目唯一保护对象。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
working in partnership with

与……共同合作

适合说明跨地区生态治理的合作关系，应明确谁和谁合作以及共同处理什么问题。

用于写作：过度捕捞涉及跨界鱼群，原文跨境物种保护中的机构协作与共享海域监管高度吻合。

protect and restore

保护并修复

protect 强调避免进一步破坏，restore 强调恢复已经受损的状态；并列时应同时存在预防与修复需要。

用于写作：可用于说明限制捕捞的生态目标，并与题目中的渔业生计相衔接。
